column1: # Pronunciation overrides for "We Wish to Inform You That Tomorrow We Will Be
# Killed with Our Families" (Gourevitch). Format: word<TAB>phonemes
#   vowels  ɑ (father)  æ (cat)  ə (about)  ɛ (bed)  ɪ (bit)  i (see)  u (boot)  ʊ (book)  ʌ (cup)  ɔ (law)
#   diphthongs  A (say)  I (my)  O (go)  W (now)  Y (boy)
#   consonants  ɡ (hard g)  ʤ (j)  ʧ (ch)  ʃ (sh)  ʒ (zh)  ŋ (sing)  ɹ (r)  j (yes)
#   stress  ˈ primary  ˌ secondary  (placed right before the stressed vowel)
# Kinyarwanda is spelled phonetically: a=ɑ e=ɛ/A i=i o=O u=u, g is always hard,
# "c" = ch, "y" = j (yes), "ny" = nj. Stress is approximated for an English narrator.
# Match is case-sensitive and whole-word; "Kagame's" is handled automatically.
# --- Groups, terms, acronyms said as words ---
